<section class="hub-hero">
  <div class="hub-eyebrow">RTM-SUITE &middot; TOOLSRTM</div>
  <h1>Leaf, canopy, soil &amp; atmosphere,<br><span class="accent">in R and Python.</span></h1>
  <p class="lead">
    ToolsRTM covers leaf optics (PROSPECT-D, PROSPECT-PRO, Fluspect-B, Fluspect-B-Cx, LIBERTY),
    canopy models (fourSAIL, foursail2, INFORM), soil optics (BSM, MARMIT) and the full
    soil&ndash;canopy&ndash;atmosphere chain (SPART) &mdash; plus LUT/parameter sampling, sensor
    convolution, vegetation indices, and trait inversion (classical ML and deep learning), in R
    and Python, kept numerically in sync and verified against each other.
  </p>
  <div class="hub-badges">
    <span class="hub-badge">PROSPECT &middot; Fluspect &middot; LIBERTY</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">fourSAIL &middot; fourSAIL2 &middot; INFORM &middot; SPART</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">MARMIT</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">LUTs &amp; sensor convolution</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">ML &amp; deep-learning inversion</span>
    <span class="hub-badge">R &amp; Python</span>
  </div>
  <div class="hub-actions">

  </div>

<div class="hub-darkcard">
  <h2>Nineteen R tutorials, one shared 20-chapter Python path</h2>
  <p>
    The R side is nineteen standalone <code>ToolsRTM</code> pkgdown articles (t01&ndash;t19),
    grouped below by theme: models themselves, then trait inversion (ML and deep learning),
    sensitivity analysis, and satellite/spatial applications. The Python side is organised
    differently &mdash; <code>toolsrtm</code> and <code>scopeinpython</code> share one continuous
    20-chapter learning path, so almost every chapter is ToolsRTM material (only Chapter 06 is
    SCOPE-specific); this page links the ToolsRTM-relevant chapters and the package-tagged code
    examples directly, and points to the full path for the complete narrative.
  </p>
</div>
